main.summary: Composes PostgreSQL transfer metadata with Azure Blob payloads for DataControl.

field.name: state
field.summary: Metadata store for sessions, ranges, chunks, and journals.

method.name: LoadObjectReferenceAsync
method.summary: Loads the persisted object reference for a transfer session.
method.returns: The tenant storage object reference, or null when the session or object reference is unavailable.

method.name: LoadStaleTransferSessionCandidatesAsync
method.summary: Loads a bounded cursor page of sessions in the selected tenant catalog whose last server-observed activity is at or before a fixed cleanup cutoff.
method.param: Inclusive activity cutoff for this scan.
Exclusive cursor from the preceding page for this tenant catalog, or null for the first page.
Maximum number of lightweight candidates to return.
method.returns: The next stale-session candidate page.

method.name: CloseReadSessionAsync
method.summary: Closes a catalog-owned PublishedRead, StagedRead, or StreamFollow session only when it is not publishing, has no publication journal, and has no dependent reader sessions.
method.returns: True when closed or already absent; otherwise false.

method.name: HasDependentSessionAsync
method.summary: Checks the selected catalog for staged-read or stream-follow sessions that still depend on the specified source.
method.returns: True when a dependent reader session exists.

method.name: LoadSegmentedRangesAsync
method.summary: Loads persisted range states for a segmented transfer session.
method.returns: Persisted ranges ordered by offset.

method.name: TouchTransferSessionAsync
method.summary: Advances the server-observed activity timestamp for one tenant-scoped session without changing its manifest or transfer state version.
method.returns: True when the matching session was touched.

method.name: EnsureManifestCatalog
method.summary: Rejects a transfer manifest whose catalog differs from the selected tenant storage context.
method.param: Catalog name declared by the manifest.

method.name: PromoteStagedReadManifestAsync
method.summary: Persists a validated published-read manifest only when its existing session is a segmented staged-read session.
method.returns: True when the staged-read session was promoted.

method.name: CreateSegmentedBlockPlanAsync
method.summary: Creates a deterministic storage block plan from the persisted segmented ranges of a session.
method.returns: The segmented block plan, or null when the session is unavailable or is not segmented.

method.name: CreateStreamBlockPlanAsync
method.summary: Creates a deterministic storage block plan from the persisted stream chunks of a session.
method.returns: The stream block plan, or null when the session is unavailable or is not a stream transfer.

method.name: SaveVerifiedSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Saves a segmented range through tenant storage while verifying its declared length and SHA-512 digest.
method.returns: Verified transfer blob reference, or null when the session is unavailable or storage rejects the payload.
method.exception: The staged payload length or SHA-512 digest does not match its declaration.

method.name: WriteSegmentedRangeCoreAsync
method.summary: Verifies or stages a segmented range and atomically commits its range state with session progress; accepts identical retries.
method.returns: The committed, replayed, or rejected range result with authoritative state version.
method.exception: The staged payload length or SHA-512 digest does not match its declaration.

method.name: CommitSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Creates the sanitized session snapshot including its immutable item instance token and atomically commits it with the verified segmented range.
method.param: Verified range metadata to persist or compare.
method.returns: The committed, replayed, or rejected range result.

method.name: SaveUnverifiedSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Saves a segmented range to tenant storage without checking a declared payload length or digest.
method.returns: Stored transfer blob reference, or null when the session is unavailable or storage returns no reference.

method.name: CommitStreamAppendAsync
method.summary: Builds the sanitized stream-session snapshot including its immutable item instance token and atomically commits it with the append chunk.
method.param: Verified append chunk metadata to persist or compare.
Session version on which the append was based.
method.returns: The committed, replayed, or rejected append result with authoritative state.

method.name: OpenSegmentedRangePartAsync
method.summary: Opens the staged blob containing one part of a segmented range.
method.param: Staged range whose blob should be opened.
method.returns: A readable staged range stream, or null when the session is unavailable.

method.name: OpenStreamChunkPartAsync
method.summary: Opens the staged blob containing one stream chunk.
method.returns: A readable staged chunk stream, or null when the session is unavailable.

method.name: ToReference
method.summary: Converts a tenant storage blob reference into a transfer blob reference.
method.returns: The equivalent transfer reference, or null when the source reference is null.

method.name: ToTenantReference
method.summary: Converts a transfer blob reference into a tenant storage blob reference.
method.returns: The equivalent tenant storage reference.

method.name: ToSegmentedFailureCode
method.summary: Maps a tenant-storage verification failure to a segmented-transfer failure code.
method.returns: The segmented-transfer failure code.
method.exception: Thrown when the storage verification failure is not recognized.

method.name: ToStreamFailureCode
method.summary: Maps a tenant-storage verification failure to a stream-transfer failure code.
method.returns: The stream-transfer failure code.
method.exception: Thrown when the storage verification failure is not recognized.
